how_it_works.title: 3 Simple Steps to Quality Healthcare Savings
how_it_works.subtitle: Engineered for simplicity on any mobile browser across urban and rural Uttar Pradesh.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Type any brand name or snap a photo of a doctor's handwritten prescription. Our Gemini Vision OCR identifies salts instantly.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Our deterministic engine finds exact salt-matched Jan Aushadhi alternatives, nearby stock, and government subsidies.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Reserve your medicine counter stock with zero prepayment. Walk in, pick up, or chat directly with the chemist.

features.title: Technology Built for Uttar Pradesh Healthcare
features.card1_desc: Fair comparisons on price-per-unit, exact salt composition, and narrow therapeutic index safety warnings. Never hallucinated.
features.card2_desc: Temporary inventory reservation locks stock so citizens don't travel in vain. Transparent counter pickup with live status stepper.
features.card3_desc: Aggregates over-the-counter fever and dehydration demand to signal disease surges days before hospital beds fill up.

demo_guide.title: Hackathon Demo Walkthrough
demo_guide.subtitle: Follow these 6 core end-to-end flows built for the AI Kaushal 24-hour hackathon

flows.title: 1. Prescription OCR Scan
flows.description: Upload a handwritten doctor prescription. Gemini Vision extracts medicines, dosage, and frequency into an editable review table.

flows.title: 2. Generic Substitution & Savings
flows.description: Deterministic substitution matches identical active salts and ranks 70%+ cheaper PM Jan Aushadhi alternatives.

flows.title: 3. 2-Hour Pickup Hold
flows.description: Reserve medicines without prepayment. A live 2-hour countdown timer temporarily locks inventory at the chemist.

flows.title: 4. Citizen-Pharmacist Real-Time Chat
flows.description: Lightweight 3-second polling chat with quick reply chips for pickup timing and generic availability confirmation.

flows.title: 5. Chemist Invoice OCR Upload
flows.description: Chemist snaps wholesale bill photo to bulk-update inventory with automated DPCO price ceiling violation checks.

flows.title: 6. UP Syndromic Surveillance Heatmap
flows.description: Detect early fever outbreak spikes in Chowk and Alambagh, and broadcast stock advisories to local pharmacies.

disclaimer.medical: Confirm with your doctor or pharmacist before switching.
